sources.title: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is a low-latency, cost-effective multimodal model optimized for high-frequency, lightweight tasks. The model supports text, image, video, audio, and PDF inputs, and is designed for high-volume agentic workflows, simple data extraction, and applications where latency and API cost are the primary constraints.
